questions.text: How mature is your carbon emissions measurement and tracking system?
Do you have Scope 1, 2, and 3 emissions calculated?
How frequently do you report on emissions?
Rate your carbon reduction initiative maturity
Do you have science-based targets?
How effectively do you manage energy consumption?
What percentage of energy comes from renewable sources?
Rate your waste reduction and circularity practices
Do you have a circular economy strategy?
How mature are your health and safety programs?
Do you have ISO 45001 or equivalent certification?
Rate your D&I program maturity
Do you have measurable D&I targets?
How effectively do you engage with local communities?
Do you have formal community engagement programs?
How effective is board oversight of ESG matters?
Does your board have ESG expertise?
Rate your ESG risk management maturity
Do you have climate risk assessments (TCFD)?
How robust are your business ethics policies?
Do you have anti-corruption training for all employees?
How mature is your data infrastructure?
Do you have a centralized data platform?
Rate your AI/ML adoption maturity
Are predictive analytics used for decision-making?
How mature is your workflow automation?
What percentage of processes are automated?
